content: A poll-based suggestion engine in a Rails 8 + Vue 3 GraphQL app should be implemented as a pure service object (Suggestions::Engine) that takes a merged collection and session context (attendee count, time budget, complexity preference) and returns a ranked shortlist. The engine is called from a GraphQL resolver (suggestions) and optionally from a mutation (runSuggestionEngine). It should not call BGG directly; instead it reads cached BGG poll data from the BggThing model (or BggPoll table). The result is computed live per request, with optional short-term cache keyed by session id. Explainability is key: each suggestion carries a score breakdown that maps to UI reason chips.
